pages.title: Lestodon
pages.text: $(o)Lestodon$() ($(o)Lestodon armatus$()) was one of the largest ground sloths, a grazer on the Pampas of Argentina, Uruguay and southern Brazil during the Pleistocene.$(br2)It had a heavy barrel body, strong clawed limbs and a very broad, square muzzle, with two pairs of tusk-like teeth at the front of its jaws.$(br2)A bed of thirteen skeletons of different ages shows that it sometimes lived in groups. It died out about 12,000 years ago.
